title: Máscara Mayday

findings.issue: Shopify custom.ingredients is a DIFFERENT product's INCI — a hydro-alcoholic fragrance-mist list, not the reconstruction mask's emulsion INCI.
findings.detail: Listing custom.ingredients = 'Aqua, Alcohol, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Parfum, Hexylene Glycol, Ceteareth-20, Glycerin, Castor Oil Propanediol Esters, Xylityl Sesquicaprylate, Caprylyl Glycol' — a classic Alcohol+PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil+Parfum fragrance-solubilization system (a body/hair mist or splash). The real Mayday label (ADESIVO) is a conditioning-mask emulsion: Aqua, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, C12-15 Alkyl Benzoate, Cetyl Alcohol, Parfum, Lactic Acid, Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine, Behentrimonium Chloride, ...Arginine, Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil, Panthenol, Persea Gratissima Oil, Linum Usitatissimum, Salvia Hispanica... The two lists share only Aqua, Parfum, Glycerin. An emulsion mask and a mist cannot share an INCI. The listed Alcohol, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Ceteareth-20, Hexylene Glycol, Castor Oil Propanediol Esters, Xylityl Sesquicaprylate, Caprylyl Glycol are NOT on the real label; the real conditioning agents (Cetearyl/Cetyl Alcohol, Behentrimonium Chloride, Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine, Panthenol, avocado/sunflower oils) are all MISSING. Fix: replace custom.ingredients with the real mask INCI transcribed from the ADESIVO label.

findings.issue: No correct full legal INCI anywhere on the listing to feed marketplaces; the one INCI-shaped field is wrong.
findings.detail: custom.caracteristicas and the description carry only benefits/actives, not a full INCI. The single INCI field (custom.ingredients) holds a foreign product's list. If pushed to Amazon 1P / Sephora / Beleza na Web (which require full legal INCI), it would publish a false ingredient declaration — listing Alcohol/PEG-40 that aren't present and omitting real actives plus label allergens (Benzyl Alcohol, Geraniol, Hexyl Cinnamal, Limonene, Linalool, Benzyl Benzoate). Source the correct full INCI from the ADESIVO label before syndicating.

findings.issue: Description heroes different actives than the on-label front panel; all named actives are real (no hallucination) but emphasis diverges.
findings.detail: shopify_descricao_markdown foregrounds 'Restart PRO' (proprietary reticulating/keratin-crosslink trade name), D-Pantenol, and 'polissacarídeos de linhaça e chia'. Panthenol, Linum Usitatissimum (linhaça) and Salvia Hispanica (chia) are all on the real label — no invented actives. But the label front panel heroes 'D-PANTENOL, ÓLEO DE ABACATE E GIRASSOL' (Persea Gratissima + Helianthus), which the description does not surface. 'Restart PRO' is a marketing name not directly mappable to a single INCI (plausibly the Arginine/Itaconic Acid/Lactic Acid crosslink chemistry on label) — keep it substantiated. Recommend aligning hero-active emphasis (add abacate/girassol) for label consistency. Ingredient-as-proof voice is respected in the description (actives bound to force/elasticity/shine).

marketplace_impact: High risk. The only INCI-shaped field on the listing (custom.ingredients) is a foreign product's mist/splash INCI, not the mask's. Any marketplace that ingests it (Amazon 1P, Sephora, Beleza na Web, Mercado Livre) would publish a false legal ingredient list — declaring Alcohol/PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil/Ceteareth-20 that are absent, while omitting the real conditioning system (Cetearyl Alcohol, Behentrimonium Chloride, Panthenol, avocado/sunflower oils) and the label's declared fragrance allergens. Full correct INCI must be sourced from the ADESIVO label, not the current listing.
